<section id="pub-explorer" class="pub-explorer" aria-label="Filter publications">
  <div class="pub-hist" role="group" aria-label="Papers per year; select a year to filter"></div>
  <div class="pub-controls">
    <input class="pub-search" type="search" placeholder="Search titles, authors, journals" aria-label="Search publications">
    <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Theme">
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="theme" data-value="forecasting">Forecasting</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="theme" data-value="markets">Markets</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="theme" data-value="optimisation">Optimisation</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="theme" data-value="energy">Energy systems</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="theme" data-value="analytics">Analytics</button>
    </div>
    <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Type">
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="kind" data-value="article">Journal</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="kind" data-value="conference">Conference</button>
      <button type="button" class="chip" data-group="kind" data-value="preprint">Preprint</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pub-status-row">
    <span class="pub-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
    <button type="button" class="pub-reset">Clear filters</button>
    <span class="spacer"></span>
    <a href="files/pinson-publications.bib">Download BibTeX</a>
    <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=8Ai6cssAAAAJ">Google Scholar</a>
  </div>
</section>
